slides.title: Small Business Saturday
slides.meta: Downtown, welcome tent on Division St
slides.body: Shop downtown with a deal guide covering 50+ businesses. Show proof of purchase from a participating shop to earn raffle tickets.

slides.title: Candlelight: Tribute to Michael Jackson
slides.body: A candlelit tribute concert of Michael Jackson songs. Tickets are sold online through Fever.

slides.title: Somerville Arts Holiday Art Show
slides.body: A holiday art show and fundraiser with work from more than 15 artists, plus music.

slides.title: Your Somerville weekend map
slides.tip: Somerville station is on NJ Transit's Raritan Valley Line. Driving? Use public parking.
